meta.title: Release v4.8.0: Bundle Size Optimization, Enhanced Coverage & Documentation
meta.body_summary: Release v4.8.0 focusing on bundle size reduction by removing es-toolkit dependency, achieving 95%+ test coverage, and overhauling documentation with Star Wars themed examples.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex released v4.8.0 with dependency removal and extensive test coverage; merged by maintainer ltwlf without blocking reviews.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1150 changed lines across 12 files, this is a medium-sized release prep by absolute volume, including dependency removal, docs, CI updates, and tests. It fits a maintainer-led performance release PR and merged without blocking reviews.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot flagged a sort comparator returning a boolean instead of a number, causing unreliable ordering; security bot warned of prototype pollution in the setByPath helper.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing es-toolkit dependency reduces bundle size and improves loading performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR replaced a utility library with custom implementations and achieved high coverage; automated bots flagged minor issues but no blocking reviews, indicating this scope is well within Agent technical capability.

detection_detail.code_reading: The author (ltwlf) authored the PR and likely performed code reading during development.
detection_detail.ci_auto: SonarQube quality gate passed, CodeQL analysis ran, and tests passed in CI.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Coverage numbers (95%+ statement) are reported but no bundle size measurements are given; performance claim is unsubstantiated.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression reported; PR merged as-is.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced es-toolkit dependency with custom lightweight utility functions (arrayDifference, arrayIntersection, keyBy, setByPath) in helpers.ts; updated jsonCompare.ts and jsonDiff.ts to use internal helpers; removed es-toolkit from package.json; added extensive tests achieving 95%+ coverage; updated documentation and CI workflows.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes by volume are in package-lock.json (386 lines) and README (237 lines); core implementation changes are ~40 lines across src/ files.
change_trajectory: chore: drop es-toolkit dependency - custom helpers added, package.json updated, lockfile regenerated.
chore: bump version to 4.8.0 and add release notes - version bump and initial release notes in README.
docs: improve Star Wars examples and fix consistency issues - extensive README rewrite.
fix: update deprecated CodeQL action from v1 to v3 - CI workflow updates.
improve: enhance GitHub workflows with best practices and security - CI and npm publish workflow improvements.
enhance: improve GitHub Actions workflows with best practices - concurrency, timeouts, summaries.
test: achieve 95% code coverage - added comprehensive Jest test cases.
chore: finalize v4.8.0 release preparations - coverage badge, README finalization, package.json keyword updates.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding unit tests for new helper functions and JSDoc comments.
review_signals.action_taken: Extensive tests were added in later commits, though JSDoc was not added.

review_signals.summary: Flagged that sort comparator returns boolean instead of number, causing unreliable ordering; suggested using localeCompare.
Flagged potential prototype pollution in setByPath helper function due to assignment using path parts.
